title: A Hard Background Pairing Transfers across Classifiers and Images
abstract: arXiv:2611.34645v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An image classifier names the object in an image, and its accuracy is the share of images named correctly. A classifier that names a car on a road may miss the same car pasted onto clouds. Composite benchmarks measure such failures by pasting objects cut from photographs onto backgrounds from other photographs. A pairing puts every object label on a different background label, such as truck on sea. The pairing on which some classifiers do worst, their hardest pairing, makes a strict test, but may be hard only for them or only on the photographs used to choose it. We show that the hardest pairing of some classifiers stays hard for others and on new photographs. We split 40 ImageNet classifiers into halves balanced by reported ImageNet accuracy. translated_title: 困难背景配对可跨分类器与图像迁移
translated_abstract: 图像分类器为图像中的物体命名，其准确率是正确命名图像的比例。一个能在道路上识别汽车的分类器，可能无法识别被粘贴到云朵背景上的同一辆汽车。复合基准测试通过将照片中裁剪出的物体粘贴到来自其他照片的背景上来衡量这类失败。一种配对方式是将每个物体标签置于不同的背景标签上，例如海面上的卡车。某些分类器表现最差的配对，即其最困难的配对，构成了一项严格的测试，但该配对可能仅对这些分类器困难，或仅在用于选择它的照片上困难。我们证明，某些分类器的最困难配对对其他分类器以及在新的照片上依然困难。我们将40个ImageNet分类器按其报告的ImageNet准确率平衡地分为两半。其中一半从Common Objects in Context（COCO）数据集中选取8个物体标签与8个背景标签的最困难配对。另一半（未参与该选择）将该配对与随机配对进行比较……
tldr: 该论文证明，对某些分类器而言最困难的物体-背景配对，对其他分类器和在新的图像上同样困难，表明这种困难性具有跨分类器和跨图像的迁移性。
en_tdlr: The hardest object-background pairing for some classifiers remains hard for other classifiers and on new photographs, demonstrating that pairing difficulty transfers across classifiers and images.
